newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIUPANK SAYS NOT INTERESTED IN LITIMPEKS BANK.
newsitem.headline: HOIUPANK SAYS NOT INTERESTED IN LITIMPEKS BANK.

text.p: Estonia's Hoiupank said on Wednesdsay that it was no longer interested in buying a stake in Lithuania's Litimpeks Bank.
"We don't see opportunities to invest in Litimpeks now," Aare Kilp, a member of Hoiupank's board, said in response to a question at a news conference.
"We will not make an offer," he said.
The bank's chairman, Olari Taal, said at the same news conference that "We have lost interest in light of our present knowledge about the bank," but would not elaborate.
Officials at Litimpeks were not immeidately available for comment.
In January, Hoiupank's board decided to discuss investment possibilities with three Lithuanian banks, Ukio Bank, the Agricultural Bank and Litimpeks Bank.
The bank said earlier that it wanted to begin operations in Lithuania by this summer.
